memories.content: [Context Note] Similar tasks have benefited from stating the imaging view first and translating laterality into anatomical landmarks before querying. One approach that worked combined an initial descriptive expert query with an independent localization check to confirm laterality before committing.

metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?
Options: {"A": "right indwelling catheter", "B": "left indwelling catheter"}
metadata.retrieval_focus: Identifying and localizing medical devices such as catheters on imaging by determining laterality (left vs right) and distinguishing correct placement from ambiguous or mirrored findings.
